title: The Signature Vision: Plastic-to-Fuel Ships
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Plastic-to-Fuel Ships.
description:
The Signature vision of Plastic-to-Fuel Ships does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature ship hulls program, charter one: master pyrolysis plants at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale ship logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate collection booms systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Plastic-to-Fuel Ships becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — The first permanent ship hulls hosts 500 residents year-round

definition: Estimates Plastic-to-Fuel Ships readiness from component maturity.

The estimator scores the six Plastic-to-Fuel Ships components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a ship hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Plastic-to-Fuel Ships Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Plastic-to-Fuel Ships: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Plastic-to-Fuel Ships — ships converting ocean plastic into fuel at sea.

Phase 1 — Prove (pyrolysis plants): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (ship logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (collection booms): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (fuel storage): ship hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and open ocean-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
